text:
nora: starting midnight surge rollout — plan is US -> EU -> APAC, canary then ramp. pin to release/redwood-infer@v2.3.1 for this wave. asking eng-sre for a quick capacity sanity (cpu/gpu/slots).

deploy-bot: Deploy initiated by nora. stage=canary, slice=us, percent=1%. logs: `canary_start: ok`, `pull model: release/redwood-infer@v2.3.1`

sanjay: checking infra now. running the mem/gpu heatcheck on the us warm pool. should have cushion for +30% throughput. will post numbers in 30s.

liz: quick question — if US looks tight, do we fallback to v2.2.9 (smaller quant) or hold traffic? prefer automatic fallback to smaller model variant.

oliver: agree with fallback to v2.2.9 but only if latency spikes >200ms p50 above baseline. keep canary at 1% until we confirm.

deploy-bot: canary update: us slice health=OK, p95 latency delta=+12ms, error rate=0.01%. continuing to 5% in 5m.

marcus: @sanjay numbers: us warm pool GPU utilization 62%, avg token latency baseline 78ms, current 92ms. thermal headroom ok. burst capacity available (12 nodes).

sanjay: running EU preflight now — pulling same config, verifying region pinning and model artifacts. will ensure we can reserve 3 burst nodes for canary.

nora: great — if EU passes, we roll EU canary (1%) then APAC warmup. change window ends 04:30. rollback window is 30m after each regional ramp.

liz: added a quick smoke prompt set to the console for quality monitoring. if quality regression >3% on eval set, auto-rollback.

deploy-bot: eu canary: preparing images, stage=canary, slice=eu, percent=1%. queuing.

oliver: couple of operational notes: 1) pin routing policy to prefer regional capacity before cross-region spill. 2) enable degraded-mode fallback to read-only cache if redis latencies spike.

marcus: APAC note: our apac warm pool cold start is ~28s for first session; recommend pre-warming 10 slots before ramp.

sanjay: EU health: GPU util 58%, p50 token latency 84ms, tail okay. reserve confirmed.

deploy-bot: eu canary started. percent=1%. health=green.

nora: ok team — proceed with US->EU completion then prewarm APAC. if any region shows >15% utilization increase or p95 latency +150ms, HOLD and ping this thread.

liz: ack. monitoring dashboards set, alert thresholds created: p95 +120ms, error rate +0.5%.

oliver: I'll be on-call for rollback decision. if we hit the latency threshold I recommend a staged rollback: 1) revert EU, 2) pin US to previous variant v2.2.9, 3) throttle APAC warmup.

deploy-bot: us ramp to 5% complete. health=green, p95 delta=+20ms.

marcus: APAC pre-warm kicked off: 10 slots prewarmed, expected ready in ~35s.

nora: thanks everyone. final checks after APAC warmup and then we'll ramp region slices to 20% over next 30m with rolling health gates. :thumbsup:

sanjay: sanity check done. ready to proceed on my mark.

liz: watchlist in console: smoke prompts, latency traces, cost delta. setting temporary alert to #eng-oncall too.

deploy-bot: roll plan summary: us -> eu -> apac; canary 1% -> 5% -> prewarm -> 20% ramp with health gates; pinned model release/redwood-infer@v2.3.1; fallback variant v2.2.9; rollback window 30m per region.

nora: perfect. initiating APAC prewarm -> then ramp. will update thread with go/no-go.

oliver: standing by. :eyes:
